G1600.def: from «1537» and a form of «4072»; to fly out, i.e. (by analogy) to extend:--stretch forth.

G1601.def: from «1537» and «4098»; to drop away; specially, be driven out of one's course; figuratively, to lose, become inefficient:--be cast, fail, fall (away, off), take none effect.

G1602.def: from «1537» and «4126»; to depart by ship:--sail (away, thence).

G1605.def: from «1537» and «4141»; to strike with astonishment:--amaze, astonish.

G1606.def: from «1537» and «4154»; to expire:--give up the ghost.

G1607.def: from «1537» and «4198»; to depart, be discharged, proceed, project:--come (forth, out of), depart, go (forth, out), issue, proceed (out of).

G1608.def: from «1537» and «4203»; to be utterly unchaste:--give self over to fornication.

G1609.def: from «1537» and «4429»; to spit out, i.e. (figuratively) spurn:--reject.

G1610.def: from «1537» and «4492»; to uproot:--pluck up by the root, root up.

G1611.def: from «1839»; a displacement of the mind, i.e. bewilderment, "ecstasy":--+ be amazed, amazement, astonishment, trance.

G1613.def: from «1537» and «5015»; to disturb wholly:--exceedingly trouble.

G1614.def: from «1537» and teino (to stretch); to extend:--cast, put forth, stretch forth (out).

G1617.def: neuter of the comparative of «1618»; more intently:--more earnestly.

G1620.def: from «1537» and «5087»; to expose; figuratively, to declare:--cast out, expound.

G1621.def: from «1537» and tinasso (to swing); to shake violently:--shake (off).

G1622.def: from «1537»; the exterior; figuratively (as a preposition) aside from, besides:--but, except(-ed), other than, out of, outside, unless, without.

G1624.def: from «1537» and the base of «5157»; to deflect, i.e. turn away (literally or figuratively):--avoid, turn (aside, out of the way).

G1625.def: from «1537» and «5142»; to rear up to maturity, i.e. (genitive case) to cherish or train:--bring up, nourish.

G1626.et: from a comparative of (1537) and titrosko (to wound)
G1626.def: from a comparative of «1537» and titrosko (to wound); a miscarriage (abortion), i.e. (by analogy) untimely birth:--born out of due time.

G1627.def: from «1537» and «5342»; to bear out (literally or figuratively):--bear, bring forth, carry forth (out).

G1628.def: from «1537» and «5343»; to flee out:--escape, flee.

G1630.def: from «1537» and «5401»; frightened out of one's wits: sore afraid, exceedingly fear.

G1631.def: from «1537» and «5453»; to sprout up:--put forth.

G1632.def: from «1537» and cheo (to pour); to pour forth; figuratively, to bestow:--gush (pour) out, run greedily (out), shed (abroad, forth), spill.

G1634.def: from «1537» and «5594»; to expire:--give (yield) up the ghost.

G1636.et: from a presumed derivative from an obsolete primary
G1636.def: feminine of a presumed derivative from an obsolete primary; an olive (the tree or the fruit):--olive (berry, tree).

G1637.def: neuter of the same as «1636»; olive oil:--oil.

G1638.def: from «1636»; an olive-orchard, i.e. (specially) the Mount of Olives:--Olivet.

G1639.def: of Hebrew origin («05867»); an Elamite or Persian:--Elamite.

G1640.def: comparative of the same as «1646»; smaller (in size, quantity, age or quality):--less, under, worse, younger.

G1641.def: from «1640»; to diminish, i.e. fall short:--have lack.

G1642.def: from «1640»; to lessen (in rank or influence):--decrease, make lower.

G1643.et: a prolonged form of a primary verb (obsolete except in certain tenses as an altern. of this) of uncertain affin
G1643.def: a prolonged form of a primary verb (obsolete except in certain tenses as an alternative of this) of uncertain affinity; to push (as wind, oars or dæmonical power):--carry, drive, row.

G1645.et: probably akin to (1643) and the base of (1640)
G1645.def: probably akin to «1643» and the base of «1640»; light, i.e. easy:--light.

G1646.et: superlative of elachus (short); used as equivalent to (3398)
G1646.def: superlative of elachus (short); used as equivalent to «3398»; least (in size, amount, dignity, etc.):--least, very little (small), smallest.

G1647.def: comparative of «1646»; far less:--less than the least.

G1648.def: of Hebrew origin («0499»); Eleazar, an Israelite:--Eleazar.

G1651.def: of uncertain affinity; to confute, admonish:--convict, convince, tell a fault, rebuke, reprove.

G1653.def: from «1656»; to compassionate (by word or deed, specially, by divine grace):--have compassion (pity on), have (obtain, receive, shew) mercy (on).

G1654.def: from «1656»; compassionateness, i.e. (as exercised towards the poor) beneficence, or (concretely) a benefaction:--alms(-deeds).

G1656.def: of uncertain affinity; compassion (human or divine, especially active):--(+ tender) mercy.

G1657.def: from «1658»; freedom (legitimate or licentious, chiefly moral or ceremonial):--liberty.

G1658.def: probably from the alternate of «2064»; unrestrained (to go at pleasure), i.e. (as a citizen) not a slave (whether freeborn or manumitted), or (genitive case) exempt (from obligation or liability):--free (man, woman), at liberty.

G1659.def: from «1658»; to liberate, i.e. (figuratively) to exempt (from moral, ceremonial or mortal liability):--deliver, make free.

G1660.def: from the alternate of «2064»; an advent:--coming.

G1661.def: from elephas (an "elephant"); elephantine, i.e. (by implication) composed of ivory:--of ivory.

G1662.def: of Hebrew origin («0471»); Eliakim, an Israelite:--Eliakim.

G1663.def: of Hebrew origin («0461»); Eliezer, an Israelite:--Eliezer.

G1664.def: of Hebrew origin (410 and «01935»); God of majesty; Eliud, an Israelite:--Eliud.

G1665.def: of Hebrew origin («0472»); Elisabet, an Israelitess:--Elisabeth.

G1666.def: of Hebrew origin («0477»); Elissaeus, an Israelite:--Elissaeus.

G1667.def: a form of «1507»; to coil or wrap:--fold up.

G1668.def: probably from «1670»; an ulcer (as if drawn together):--sore.

G1669.def: from «1668»; to cause to ulcerate, i.e. (passively) be ulcerous:--full of sores.

G1670.def: or helko hel'-ko; probably akin to «138»; to drag (literally or figuratively):--draw. Compare «1667».

G1671.def: of uncertain affinity; Hellas (or Greece), a country of Europe:--Greece.

G1672.def: from «1671»; a Hellen (Grecian) or inhabitant of Hellas; by extension a Greek-speaking person, especially a non-Jew:-- Gentile, Greek.

G1674.def: feminine of «1672»; a Grecian (i.e. non-Jewish) woman:--Greek.

G1675.def: from a derivative of «1672»; a Hellenist or Greek-speaking Jew:--Grecian.

G1676.def: adverb from the same as «1675»; Hellenistically, i.e. in the Grecian language:--Greek.

G1677.et: from (1722) and (3056) (in the sense of account)
G1677.def: from «1722» and «3056» (in the sense of account); to reckon in, i.e. attribute:--impute, put on account.

G1678.def: of Hebrew origin (perhaps for «0486»); Elmodam, an Israelite:--Elmodam.

G1679.def: from «1680»; to expect or confide:--(have, thing) hope(-d) (for), trust.

G1680.et: from a primary elpo (to anticipate, usually with pleasure)
G1680.def: from a primary elpo (to anticipate, usually with pleasure); expectation (abstractly or concretely) or confidence:--faith, hope.

G1681.def: of foreign origin; Elymas, a wizard:--Elymas.

G1682.et: of Aramaic origin, (0426) with pronominal stuff.
G1682.def: of Chaldean origin (426 with pronominal suffix) my God:--Eloi.

G1684.def: from «1722» and the base of «939»; to walk on, i.e. embark (aboard a vessel), reach (a pool):--come (get) into, enter (into), go (up) into, step in, take ship.

G1685.def: from «1722» and «906»; to throw on, i.e. (figuratively) subject to (eternal punishment):--cast into.

G1686.def: from «1722» and «911»; to whelm on, i.e. wet (a part of the person, etc.) by contact with a fluid:--dip.

G1687.et: from (1722) and a presumed derivative of the base of (939)
G1687.def: from «1722» and a presumed derivative of the base of «939»; equivalent to «1684»; to intrude on (figuratively):--intrude into.

G1688.et: from (1722) and bibazo (to mount, causative of (1684))
G1688.def: from «1722» and bibazo (to mount; causative of «1684»); to place on, i.e. transfer (aboard a vessel):--put in.

G1689.def: from «1722» and «991»; to look on, i.e. (relatively) to observe fixedly, or (absolutely) to discern clearly:--behold, gaze up, look upon, (could) see.

G1690.et: from (1722) and brimaomai (to snort with anger)
G1690.def: from «1722» and brimaomai (to snort with anger); to have indignation on, i.e. (transitively) to blame, (intransitively) to sigh with chagrin, (specially) to sternly enjoin:--straitly charge, groan, murmur against.

G1691.def: a prolonged form of «3165»; me:--I, me, my(-self).

G1692.def: of uncertain affinity; to vomit:--(will) spue.

G1693.def: from «1722» and «3105»; to rave on, i.e. rage at:--be mad against.

G1694.def: of Hebrew origin («06005»); God with us; Emmanuel, a name of Christ:--Emmanuel.

G1695.def: probably of Hebrew origin (compare «03222»); Emmaus, a place in Palestine:--Emmaus.

G1696.def: from «1722» and «3306»; to stay in the same place, i.e. (figuratively) persevere:--continue.

G1697.def: of Hebrew origin («02544»); Emmor (i.e. Chamor), a Canaanite:--Emmor.

G1698.def: a prolonged form of «3427»; to me:--I, me, mine, my.

G1699.def: from the oblique cases of «1473» (1698, «1700», «1691»); my:--of me, mine (own), my.
